meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (National Jurisdiction; GAFI Central Registration, Commercial Registry and Notary Public District of Cairo)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Civil Law system derived from the French codified tradition, with residual Islamic Sharia influence (Constitution of 2014, Article 2), operating through the ordinary court hierarchy, the State Council administrative courts, and a dual-track regime placing company formation under both the Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and the Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) as the single competent registry
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-United States Bilateral Investment Treaty (effective 27 June 1992)
EU-Egypt Association Agreement (in force 2004; establishment, capital movements and dispute-resolution provisions)
Egypt-United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement (effective 1 January 2021)
Egypt-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (active; reciprocal promotion and protection of investments)
COMESA investment framework and regional double-taxation avoidance network (Egypt is a member state)
Egypt-UAE and Egypt-Saudi Arabia Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (active capital-corridor treaties)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering, as amended by Law No. 181 of 2008 and subsequent amendments, with consolidated Executive Regulations issued by Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2907 of 2021; counter-terrorism financing regime of Law No. 106 of 2013 and Law No. 8 of 2015; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017) mandating GAFI ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) declarations; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, as amended; GAFI Central Disclosure and UBO declaration forms; CDD and UBO rules issued by the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Combating Unit (EMLCU) implementing FATF Recommendations 10, 12, 24 and 25; Central Bank of Egypt directives applicable to corporate account onboarding

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Notary of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization chain, then certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Corporate-seal notarization, followed by Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization chain, then certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copies of the passports and residence proofs of each shareholder, director and ultimate beneficial owner (UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction notary public or competent passport-issuing authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization chain, then certified Arabic translation; appended to the GAFI UBO declaration

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds evidence for the share capital to be remitted into the Egyptian corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Remitting bank in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank-letterhead document, notarized, then Hague Apostille or Egyptian consular legalization; retained in the EMLCU-standard CDD file

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bilingual (Arabic/English) Memorandum of Association of the Egyptian LLC, incorporating commercial objects, capital structure and the UBO disclosure annex
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Public Notary (Notary Public Office - التوثيق, Cairo)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal Egyptian notarization only; no Apostille required; registration perfected at the GAFI One Stop Shop

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-registration screening of every shareholder, director, authorized signatory and UBO against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN and sectoral sanctions lists, EU CFSP sanctions, UK HMT sanctions, and Egypt's domestic terrorist entities list maintained by the Terrorist Entities and Terrorists Listing Committee under Law No. 8 of 2015, with official designation notices published in the Egyptian Official Gazette. PEP status must be identified at onboarding in line with FATF Recommendation 12 and EMLCU instructions, covering foreign and domestic PEPs, immediate family members and close associates, with enhanced due diligence (EDD) documentation retained for ten years. For this Medium_Risk_Enhanced real-time video-matching and social-telephony activity, the screening protocol is further applied to the Apple IAP and Paymentwall settlement payment rails on an ongoing basis, with monitoring filters refreshed at least quarterly and before each capital remittance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Electronic One Stop Shop and company registration module (GAFI e-services / Sharikaty portal, reachable through eservices.gafi.gov.eg), with the name search cross-matched against the Egyptian Commercial Registry database and the records of the Egyptian Trademarks Office under the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory Arabic name requirement: every limited liability company must adopt an Arabic-language corporate name, accompanied by a parallel Latin-character transliteration for courts, banks and cross-border contracts. The name must be original, not identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered company or protected trademark, and must not mislead the public as to activity, nationality or governmental affiliation. The suffix 'ذات مسؤولية محدودة' (Limited Liability Company / LLC) is mandatory. Once approved, the exact name must appear on the Cairo registered-office signage, corporate seal, commercial correspondence, website terms and mobile application store listing.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Credit, Financial Institution - requires prior written approval of the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and a banking license under Law No. 194 of 2020
Insurance, Reinsurance, Ta'min - requires prior approval of the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA)
Securities, Brokerage, Exchange, Investment Fund - requires the FRA capital-markets authorization regime
National, Republic, Government, Ministerial, Army, Military, Police, and Egyptian flag/emblem references - reserved for state bodies; ministerial approval required for any national-denoting token
Islamic, Jihad, and Sharia-affiliated tokens - require prior approval of the Ministry of Endowments (Awqaf) and compatibility with public order
Telecom, Telecommunications, Mobile/Cellular Network Operator tokens - require prior NTRA endorsement given the real-time video and voice telephony objects of the proposed activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The GAFI name-clearance certificate is valid for thirty (30) calendar days. A one-time extension may be obtained by filing the GAFI extension request online before expiry, quoting the original clearance reference and paying the renewal fee. Upon rejection, the applicant may immediately re-file a revised name. An administrative appeal must be lodged with GAFI's Investment Grievances Committee within thirty (30) days of the written rejection, stating the grounds of distinctiveness; the Committee decides within thirty days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may bring an annulment action before the Cairo Administrative Court (State Council) within sixty (60) days of the final administrative decision. Practical SOP: submit three alternative names at first filing to protect the critical path of incorporation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as a standalone arrangement. Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 and GAFI implementing instructions require a real, physical registered head office (المقر الرئيسي) inside Egypt where statutory books, seals and corporate records are maintained and official notifications may be served. A serviced office or business-center lease with a dedicated physical suite, installed nameplate and commercial mail handling is accepted in practice and constitutes the minimum viable substance for a digital-only enterprise; pure mail-forwarding or fully virtual addresses are rejected at GAFI registration and cannot support corporate bank account opening. Given the mobile application's digital nature, a light physical presence is commercially reasonable, but the physical address must be secured and evidenced before the GAFI proof-of-address submission.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk is moderate-to-low: an estimated 10-15% annual probability of an unannounced GAFI or Commercial Registry verification visit during the first three years for a purely digital entity. The probability rises to approximately 30-40% once Egyptian VAT registration thresholds or e-invoicing obligations are activated, and to approximately 45% if the NTRA concludes that the real-time video and voice features require a telecom-content authorization, which would trigger coordinated multi-agency on-site substance checks by GAFI, NTRA and the Egyptian Tax Authority. During a dormant holding year, inspection risk is estimated below 10%.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended), governing Limited Liability Companies, read with its Executive Regulations issued by the Minister of Investment, and supplemented by the transitional Companies Law No. 4 of 2025 (which removes fixed minimum capital thresholds for LLCs); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, Article 9, and its Executive Regulations establishing the GAFI One-Stop-Shop for incorporation, commercial registration, and post-formation licensing coordination.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Company Registration Department (One-Stop-Shop), acting jointly with the Commercial Registry Office and the Ministry of Justice Notary Public office attached to GAFI.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of a Limited Liability Company executed before a public notary and filed electronically through the GAFI corporate establishment portal, together with the bank capital deposit certificate, name reservation certificate, and registered office lease documentation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No fixed statutory minimum capital applies to an LLC under Companies Law No. 4 of 2025; the transitional Executive Regulations recommend a minimum subscribed capital of EGP 50,000. At least 10% of the subscribed capital must be deposited in a temporary escrow (capital deposit) account at a licensed Egyptian bank, evidenced by a bank-issued capital deposit certificate submitted with the incorporation application; the balance is payable within five years. Capital may be denominated in EGP or convertible foreign currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Members ratify the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company as an Egyptian Limited Liability Company under the Companies Law, and approve the subscription and allotment of the entire share capital to the founding members. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company is established at its principal place of business in Cairo, Egypt, and the lease documentation is approved for filing with the Commercial Registry. RESOLVED, that [Name Surname] is appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name Surname] Chief Financial Officer, and [Name Surname] Corporate Secretary, each authorized severally to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and submit regulatory filings. RESOLVED, that all acts of the incorporators and officers to date are ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop / Commercial Registry Name Reservation Desk, Cairo Investment Services Center (electronic submission via the GAFI Establishment Portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an electronic name reservation request listing three alternative proposed trade names, each ending with the legal format 'LLC'. The name must be distinctive, not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered trademark or corporate name, and not contain prohibited religious or sovereign terms. The approved name reservation is valid for 60 days and must be renewed if the incorporation application is not lodged within that period.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of all founding members and managers
Three proposed trade names with Arabic transliterations
Draft statement of purpose referencing ISIC 6311 (data processing, hosting, and online platform activities)
Power of attorney if submission is made through an authorized agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected, file a supplementary reservation request with new alternates; disputes regarding similarity to an existing name may be appealed in writing to the GAFI Registration Committee, which will decide within five working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution, and Notarization of the Incorporation Contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office attached to GAFI (Ministry of Justice) and the drafting counsel of the founding members.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Arabic (with optional English translation) Memorandum and Articles of Association using the GAFI model template for LLCs. The instrument must state the corporate object (real-time video matching, social telephony application, data hosting, and related digital services), the subscribed capital, each member's share, the registered office address in Cairo, and the management structure. All founding members or their appointed representatives must appear in person before the GAFI-attached notary with valid identification; upon execution, the notary issues the certified establishment contract for submission.
required_dossiers: Approved name reservation certificate
Valid passports or national identity cards of all founding members
Notarized Arabic power of attorney if representatives sign
Approved activity classification schedule (ISIC 6311 / NAICS 519130)
Proposed registered office address with title or lease evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies inconsistencies between the stated objects and the commercial activity codes, amend the Articles by a supplementary declaration and re-notarize; the first resubmission is exempt from additional notarial fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Deposit into Temporary Escrow Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., a national bank with multi-currency corporate onboarding desk).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary icebox (company under formation) deposit account in the name of the prospective LLC. Each founding member transfers their subscribed contribution in EGP or an approved foreign currency. The bank conducts enhanced customer due diligence consistent with the medium-risk AML classification of video-chat application businesses, including beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declarations. Upon full receipt of the required portion of capital, the bank issues the capital deposit certificate, which must be preserved in original form for the GAFI filing.
required_dossiers: Notarized copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
Passport and resolved KYC/CTF questionnaires of all members
Source-of-funds declaration and corporate onboarding form
Name reservation certificate and draft commercial registration data sheet
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses onboarding or requests additional information due to the enhanced commercial risk tier, provide a sworn declaration that the platform excludes unlawful dating, gambling, or prohibited content, and resubmit to an alternative licensed bank; the deposit certificate remains valid for 90 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop Application and Issuance of Incorporation Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Company Registration Department (One-Stop-Shop) - electronic file review and physical counter clearance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the complete incorporation file on the GAFI electronic platform and schedule a counter appointment. Pay the fixed registration fee, notarial/stamp duties on share capital, and Official Gazette publication fee online. GAFI simultaneously registers the company with the Commercial Registry, alerts the Egyptian Tax Authority for tax card issuance, and coordinates social insurance registration. Upon final legal review, GAFI issues the incorporation certificate and the commercial registration extract, which constitute conclusive proof of corporate legal personality and ability to commence non-licensed activities.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate
Approved name reservation certificate
Passport copies and recent official addresses of all shareholders and managers
Registered office lease or usufruct deed with minimum one-year term
Beneficial ownership schedule in the prescribed GAFI format
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI issues a query regarding the activity clause, foreign ownership structure, or AML profile, respond with a legal opinion letter within 15 working days clarifying that the over-the-top video-matching service is not a licensed telecommunications activity and that 100% foreign ownership is permissible under the Investment Law; GAFI must resolve the query before the statutory deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, Social Insurance, Payment of Fees, and Post-Registration Formalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), General Authority for Social Insurance, Official Gazette publication office, and relevant financial intelligence reporting channels.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receipt of the commercial registration extract, apply electronically to the ETA for the tax card, register for payroll tax, and complete VAT registration if taxable supplies exceed the statutory threshold. Register all managers and employees with the social insurance authority within 14 days. Effect the mandatory publication of the incorporation summary in the Official Gazette. Where in-app payments are routed through Apple IAP and Paymentwall, notify the competent tax office of the cross-border revenue stream and maintain parallel accounting records in EGP and settlement currencies.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration extract and incorporation certificate
GAFI-approved Articles of Association
Tax card application forms and manager identification
Social insurance registration data schedules
Registered office lease contract
Bank account opening certificate and employer bank mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax card is delayed pending ETA field inspection, file a customer service escalation and obtain an interim provisional tax number, which allows the company to proceed with banking and contracting formalities; the provisional number is later replaced by the definitive tax card without additional charge.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - the company operates solely as a knowledge-based over-the-top (OTT) data processing and real-time video-matching software provider with office-only premises and no manufacturing plant. If the company later deploys physical hosting infrastructure, the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology and the National Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (NTRA) will exercise oversight, and any physical data center will additionally require a governorate building permit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license is required for the pure OTT software activity under Telecommunications Law No. 10 of 2003. A voluntary NTRA value-added service registration is recommended for direct inbound telephony routing; a dedicated data center hosting license becomes mandatory only if the company operates its own physical switching or server infrastructure.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Environmental Licensing Department, operating under Law No. 4 of 1994 as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: White List (Exempt) - knowledge-based service activity with no industrial processes is exempt from full environmental impact assessment screening and from the mandatory environmental compliance plan; the company maintains only an annual office-level self-audit covering energy use and segregated waste disposal.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or combustion discharge thresholds apply. Office premises must comply with Cairo Governorate noise limits (55 dB(A) daytime), and all electronic equipment and server waste must be segregated and transferred to accredited recyclers under Waste Management Law No. 202 of 2020; standby generators, if installed, require air-emission compliance certification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Organization fire-safety certification for the registered office perimeter (fire alarms, extinguishers, and evacuation signage), Ministry of Manpower occupational safety and health inspection clearance under Labor Law No. 12 of 2003, and, where server racks or heavy IT equipment are installed, a structural loading certificate from the competent governorate engineering authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance, Cairo; official e-portal: https://eta.gov.eg; customs electronic single window: NAFEZA (National Single Window for Foreign Trade Facilitation).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor incorporates the LLC through the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) one-stop shop, obtaining the Commercial Registration (CR) and National Identification Number (NIF). The entity then files statutory registration with the Egyptian Tax Authority via its e-portal, which issues the Tax Identification Number (TIN) and tax card. VAT registration is subsequently filed on the same ETA e-portal when annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000 or voluntarily when below the threshold. Finally, the LLC must activate its ETA digital signature keys for the mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt systems.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election is available in Egypt; the LLC is mandatorily taxed as an entity-level corporate taxpayer under Law No. 26/2025 (Unified Tax Procedures Law) and Law No. 91/2005, applying Egyptian GAAP. Available elections include voluntary VAT registration below the EGP 500,000 compulsory threshold, election for investment-law tax incentives or free-zone treatment under Investment Law No. 72/2017, and application for an Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) covering the cross-border transfer-pricing positions of the video-matching platform. Hybrid mismatch outcomes are governed solely by substance-over-form and Egypt's MLI positions; no separate statutory hybrid election exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67/2016, as amended by Law No. 102/2017
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 of annual value of taxable supplies of goods and services; compulsory registration once exceeded and available on a voluntary basis below that ceiling.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing applies to all VAT-registered taxpayers under ETA implementing decisions (e.g., Decision No. 194/2020): invoices must be generated in the approved XML/JSON schema, submitted in real time to the ETA gateway through the REST/JSON API or portal, validated against master data, fiscally cleared in near-real time, and stamped with an ETA UUID, cryptographic hash and dynamic QR code. B2C consumer sales, including App Store/in-app subscription fees, require the complementary e-receipt system. Invoices not submitted, rejected, or filed late are legally not issued and trigger ETA penalty assessments.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for the 0% rate where the LLC proves physical export of eligible goods from Egypt via the NAFEZA customs declaration and delivery to a non-resident buyer. Export services, including B2B cross-border video-matching and social telephony SaaS-related services, qualify where the service is supplied to a non-resident who does not have a permanent establishment in Egypt, is wholly performed and consumed outside Egypt, is evidenced by non-residence certificates, and the foreign currency consideration is received into an Egyptian bank account. Supplies to Egyptian end-users, including local consumption of in-app video chat credits, remain taxable in Egypt at 14%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ETA zero-rated e-invoice with export indicator, UUID, hash and QR code
NAFEZA Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document) / exit confirmation
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill or electronic load certificate evidencing physical export
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificate of Inward Transfer) from an Egyptian bank
Export contract, commercial invoice, payment evidence and non-residence certificate for services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating claims are subject to documentary substance checks by the ETA during the 5-year assessment window. Ineligible or poorly documented claims are reversed, resulting in assessment of 14% standard-rate VAT on the gross sales value, disallowance and clawback of corresponding input VAT, and a late-payment surcharge of 2% per month on the tax due. Administrative fines of up to 100% of the evaded VAT apply for negligent non-compliance; amid indicators of fraud, criminal prosecution under Law No. 176/2020 (Tax Evasion Law) imposes imprisonment, monetary fines of three to five times the evaded tax, and automatic suspension of the entity's e-invoicing and export zero-rating eligibility.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — including its Foreign Exchange Control, Banking Licensing, and AML/CFT supervision departments — acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020; the Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade and the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) handle capital admission and investor registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Egyptian Pound (EGP) is a partially convertible managed-flexible currency. Current-account transactions, including trade payments, service fees, royalties, and operational remittances, are executable through authorized banks upon presentation of underlying contracts, invoices, customs declarations, or tax documentation, generally without prior central-bank licensing. Capital-account transactions, including foreign equity injections, shareholder loans, and divestment or liquidation repatriations, are subject to case-by-case CBE/GAFI registration and must flow through the Egyptian banking system. Profit and dividend remittances are lawful but require audited financial statements, tax-clearance certificates, evidence that the founding capital entered Egypt through a recognized bank channel, and matching of the company's CBE-recorded foreign-exchange position. Following the March 2024 unification of the official and market exchange rates, conversion occurs at the prevailing interbank rate, which has materially improved remittance practicality and reduced the prior parallel-market distortion.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The CBE requires full repatriation of 100% of export proceeds to an account held at an authorized Egyptian bank within the statutory period: 180 days from the bill-of-lading or customs-export date for goods, and 90 days from the invoice date for services and intellectual-property royalties, unless the CBE approves a longer contractual collection tenor. No fixed mandatory conversion percentage is currently imposed under the post-March 2024 flexible-rate framework; repatriated foreign currency may be retained in a foreign-currency account at an authorized bank, sold to the bank at the prevailing market rate, or applied toward permitted obligations, provided the company supplies the bank with the final export invoice, customs bill of lading, digital-service contract, and the required CBE statistical reporting declarations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Moderate overall. Offshore digital EMI platforms, such as Wise, Revolut Business, Payoneer, and similar services, are not recognized by the CBE as deposit-taking institutions and cannot hold the statutory capital subscription for an Egyptian LLC, nor can they satisfy CBE export-proceeds repatriation or profit-remittance requirements. Such platforms may serve only as auxiliary payment-collection or payout utilities for foreign users through licensed payment aggregators; the LLC's statutory capital, EGP liquidity, and all foreign currency related to Egyptian exports or foreign investment must reside on the books of a CBE-licensed bank. Any payment service provider handling the app for Egyptian users must also satisfy CBE and National Payment Council approval requirements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBE-licensed banks generally require at least one authorized local signatory and the company's legal representative to attend a physical onboarding interview at an Egyptian branch. Non-resident directors may satisfy identity verification through apostilled passports, corporate authorization documents, and a risk-based video meeting with the bank's compliance officer, but most tier-1 banks in practice expect a physical meeting in Egypt or at a substantial correspondent branch. A fully remote opening with no local physical presence is rarely granted to foreign-owned LLCs engaged in digital social content, and ultimate beneficial owners must be disclosed and positively verified under Egypt's AML Law No. 80 of 2002 and CBE enhanced-due-diligence instructions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ownership without clear local substance or operational footprint in Egypt
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI incorporation certificate, executed local lease agreement, Egyptian payroll and social-insurance records, board minutes appointing a local manager, domestic tax-registration documents, and a business plan showing ongoing Egyptian operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media or reputational risk attached to random-video-match social telephony applications
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Content-moderation and age-verification policy, user code of conduct, takedown and abuse-response procedures, privacy policy aligned with Egypt's Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, and independent audit reports covering child-safety, anti-bot, and anti-transaction-laundering controls.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual micro-transaction payout patterns inconsistent with the declared ISIC 6311 business scope and the Apple IAP/Paymentwall settlement rails
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed merchant-of-record agreements between the LLC and Apple IAP and Paymentwall, consolidated settlement reports reconciled to anticipated bank statements, an AML transaction-monitoring framework, refund and chargeback policies, per-user payment caps, and documented reconciliation of virtual-currency tokens to fiat flows.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or high-risk jurisdictional exposure of shareholders, traffic-origin countries, or commercial counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening logs, IP-geolocation and VPN-blocking documentation, country-access denial lists, positive-identification beneficial-owner register, and negative-media screening certificates issued by a recognized global due-diligence provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for initial shareholder capital injection cannot be fully verified
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized bank statements from the remitting shareholder's bank, source-of-wealth affidavit, audited financial statements if the shareholder is a corporate entity, legalized incorporation documents and board resolutions of the ultimate parent, and correspondent-bank references delivered directly to the Egyptian bank's compliance team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected chargeback ratios or third-party-rail settlement mismatches arising from consumer digital payments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent compliance certification of anti-fraud and chargeback-monitoring systems, documented end-user terms and cancellation policies, PCI-DSS attestation from relevant payment parties, and a historical transaction-risk assessment if the app operates in other jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing requires: (1) opening a temporary capital-subscription account at a CBE-licensed bank before incorporation; (2) wiring the foreign shareholder equity via SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate source bank, with remittance field 70 clearly stating 'Equity Capital Contribution to EG LLC' and the CBE statistical classification for direct investment equity capital; (3) obtaining a bank-issued capital deposit certificate for the notary; (4) registering the LLC with GAFI and the Commercial Registry; and (5) releasing the subscribed funds to the operational account. The full trail — SWIFT MT103 confirmations, CBE capital registration records, the bank's capital-attestation certificate, and the notarized incorporation deed — must be retained as the documentary backbone for future dividend repatriation and shareholder-loan servicing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Direct foreign vendor payments and operational disbursements are executed through SWIFT MT103 remittances from the Egyptian relationship bank, supported by invoices, contracts, and tax-clearance certificates. For physical imports or significant licensing procurement, the LLC may use documentary Commercial Letters of Credit issued through the Egyptian banking channel and registered on the National Single Window for foreign trade. All outbound transfers are matched against the LLC's CBE-reported foreign-exchange position and are subject to applicable Egyptian withholding-tax clearance and documentary confirmation of the underlying commercial purpose before the EGP account is debited.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts on EGP/USD supported by underlying commercial or investment exposure, with tenors typically up to 12 months and documented through the relationship bank.
Onshore FX swaps (spot/forward combinations) executed in the CBE interbank market for working-capital and timing-match purposes.
Cross-currency swaps covering long-term foreign shareholder loans or foreign-currency liabilities of the LLC, provided the underlying exposure is fully documented.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted only as a complementary overlay where an onshore deliverable hedge is unavailable; the underlying exposure must be evidenced and the NDF must not create a speculative foreign-exchange position.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 193)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 30 for calendar-year entities; within 4 months of fiscal year-end for non-calendar periods
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of EGP 500–20,000; late-payment surcharge of 1.5% per month on unpaid tax; potential tax card freeze and restriction on public-sector transactions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) – Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the shareholders' general assembly approval; the approval meeting must be held within 6 months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warning and step-by-step financial penalties; continued non-filing may trigger administrative strike-off from the commercial registry after official notifications.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Dependent Tax Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before the tax card expiry date (commonly renewed in January for the calendar year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired tax card prevents clearance for customs, government tenders, and import/export activity; renewal penalty of EGP 100 plus monthly delay fines.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Social Insurance Payroll Declaration (Form 103 and supplementary statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual consolidated payroll return due by March 31 for the preceding year; monthly contribution remittances remain due on their statutory dates
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly penalty of 2% of outstanding contributions for first 30 days, then 1% per month; personal liability of directors for unpaid dues and risk of criminal prosecution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all Egyptian limited liability companies under Companies Law No. 159/1981; an independent certified auditor must be appointed by the shareholders regardless of size, capital, or revenue
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as issued by the Cairo Center for Accounting and Auditing and largely aligned with IFRS; multinational entities may also apply full IFRS if required by parent or GAFI

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Egyptian law does not prescribe a separate annual UBO return, but every LLC must maintain an updated Register of Members identifying quota holders; any transfer of quotas must be registered and reported to GAFI after approval. For tax and AML purposes, the company must disclose natural persons holding 10% or more of equity or control, and confirm this ownership structure in the annual corporate tax return and upon any GAFI register audit.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minutes of Shareholders' Meetings and Manager Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 300 – 1,200 depending on Cairo versus governorate location and service level
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 800 – 2,500 for a small to mid-sized LLC with video-app operations, depending on transaction volume and cross-border flows

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (uniform corporate income tax rate under Law No. 91/2005 as amended, applicable to EG_LLC as a private limited liability company)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory effective rate is 22.5% in the absence of incentives. Investment Law No. 72/2017 offers up to a 50% reduction of tax payable for up to 7 years for qualifying projects in promoted sectors and geographical zones, including the Suez Canal Economic Zone, and a possible 100% free-zone exemption; however, a video-match social app under ISIC 6311 does not automatically qualify and requires prior GAFI and ETA approval. R&D, training, and export-linked expenses are deductible; tax credits are non-refundable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 8 - Annual Corporate Income Tax Return; mandatorily e-filed through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal under the unified Tax File Number (TFN).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (with quarterly provisional advance payments filed separately).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 4 months after the fiscal year-end (Article 68, Law No. 91/2005). The fiscal year is normally the calendar year unless an ETA-approved different year has been adopted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, TFN, commercial registry number, registered office, ISIC 6311 activity code, shareholding structure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all foreign shareholders with jurisdiction of residence, foreign tax IDs, and TRC evidence; the LLC files as a resident taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All gross receipts including gross Apple IAP/Paymentwall settlement proceeds before merchant commissions and chargebacks, net of VAT collected.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a non-resident PE operates in Egypt, include only revenues sourced to and attributable to the PE; worldwide revenue is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 (Cost of Sales / Service Delivery Costs)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs: cloud hosting, bandwidth, content licensing, app store commissions (Apple 30% / Paymentwall fees), payment processing charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disallowed unless evidenced by valid invoices/e-invoices and supported by contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Box 2 less Box 3, computed by the system.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: PE profit attribution follows Article 40 TP allocation rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, marketing, legal, IT, office, and other operating expenses incurred for the Egyptian activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Head-office recharge, management fees, and group allocations require a Local File and arm's length benchmarks.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible provisions, personal expenses, excessive entertainment, unqualified donations, and net interest expense in excess of 30% EBITDA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Thin-cap add-back equally applies to interest paid to foreign related lenders; 20% WHT exposure remains.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Brought-forward tax losses used in the tax period, capped at 5 years, no carryback.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PE may only offset accumulated PE losses derived in Egypt; no cross-border loss pooling.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable base after Boxes 4-7 adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Comprises solely Egypt-source taxable income attributable to the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unified tax computed at the statutory rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The same flat rate applies to PE profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment incentive reductions, free-zone exemptions, DTA foreign-tax credits, and advance instalments credited.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit only if a DTA so provides and with TRC/EIF evidence; incentive credits require prior ETA/GAFI approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net result after credits; payable into the unified treasury account or refund claimed from ETA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments/refunds are executed only through the Egyptian bank account of record.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of all related-party transactions, method applied, and amounts with the local subsidiary's TP declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident related parties (owner, payment processors, IP licensor) must be fully identified; failure to disclose triggers ETA audit and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed administrative penalty of up to EGP 20,000 plus a 2% monthly delay surcharge on the unpaid tax for each month or fraction of a month (Article 139, Law No. 91/2005). Late payment accrues the 2% monthly surcharge; deliberate non-filing escalates to 100%-300% evasion fines and criminal prosecution.
